humanTitle: People cannot reach anyone when a ride goes wrong
whoItAffects: iPhone and Android riders in the UK and United States, across three app versions.

build.proposition: A defined set of trip states that always route to a person.
specifics: Name the states: no vehicle arrived, repeated cancellation, disputed charge
Escalate on the state rather than on what the rider typed
Start with the repeated-cancellation path reviewers describe
build.limitation: Deflection is the point of the current design, so this is a cost decision rather than an engineering one.

start.proposition: Advocacy for riders after a trip goes wrong.
specifics: Takes the trip reference and the charge, then pursues the claim
start.limitation: Individual claims are small, and the effort per claim does not shrink with volume.

study.proposition: Which trip problems can automation actually close?
specifics: Classify reported problems by whether automation resolved them
Identify the categories where a person was always required
study.limitation: Only the platform sees resolution, so classification depends on rider accounts.

write.proposition: The support menu with no exit.
specifics: Walk the menu tree to its end and show where it stops
Use the reviews where the option simply is not there
write.limitation: Gig-platform reporting is crowded; the narrow subject here is the menu itself.
